Children Rescued in Separate Incidents Amidst Trafficking and Conversion Allegations

In two separate incidents, law enforcement agencies have rescued children. In Hyderabad, police rescued a three-year-old, leading to the busting of a suspected trafficking racket. Separately, Railway Police in Rajasthan rescued seven tribal children who were allegedly part of a religious conversion racket. These events highlight concerns regarding child safety and illegal activities.
